Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

such adjective

also such a, like that, of that kind, such … as, such is the case, such a big

classical

Phaedr. 3.9.6: tam angustam tālis vir pōnis domum?
Sen. Ep. 75.1: quālis sermō meus esset … tālēs esse epistulās meās volō
Traupman 387

tālis, tāle

adjective, third declension; answered by quālis · Declension on Wiktionary

such, of such a kind

Of kind. Its pair is quālis: tālis … quālis, such … as.

Other words

  • tantus, tanta, tantum — so great, such a big

    adjective; answered by quantus · also used · classical · Verg. A. 2.594: quis indomitās tantus dolor excitat īrās? · Declension on Wiktionary

    Of size and amount: tantus … quantus, as great … as.

  • tam (+ adjective) — such (a), so

    adverb, before an adjective or adverb · also used · classical · Phaedr. 3.9.6: tam angustam … domum · Wiktionary

    English “such a small house” is tam angusta domus, “so small a house”.

  • ejus modī (hujus modī) — of that (this) kind, that sort of

    genitive of quality, after its noun · also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 5.48: pompā, lūdīs atque ejus modī spectāculīs

    See “kind”.

Examples

  • quaesō, tam angustam tālis vir pōnis domum? — utinam, inquit, vērīs hanc amīcīs impleam!

    Tell me, does a man like you build himself so small a house? — I only wish, he said, I could fill it with true friends!Phaedr. 3.9.6–7

  • ō suāvis anima! quāle tē dīcam bonum antehāc fuisse, tālēs cum sint reliquiae?

    O sweet breath! How good must you have been before, when your dregs are such as these?Phaedr. 3.1.5–6

  • quālis sermō meus esset sī ūnā dēsidērēmus aut ambulārēmus, inlabōrātus et facilis, tālēs esse epistulās meās volō

    I want my letters to be such as my talk would be if we were sitting or walking together: unlaboured and easySen. Ep. 75.1

  • nāte, quis indomitās tantus dolor excitat īrās? quid furis?

    My son, what pain so great stirs up such wild anger? Why are you raging?Verg. A. 2.594–595

  • Rēs sē ita habet.

    Such is the case.Traupman 387

See also kind, what kind of, how much.
